output_list.criticism: The tokens are distributed randomly, which can lead to token devalue. The reason is that the tokens are distributed based on the value variable, which is updated in the getTokens function. The value variable is updated in the getTokens function by dividing 100000 of totalRemaining by 2500. This means that the tokens are distributed in a way that the first 2500 investors will get 1 token, the next 2500 investors will get 2 tokens, and so on. This means that the tokens are not distributed proportionally to the investors.
